title: fix: make production Gen secret sync opt-in
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Stops production pushes from automatically uploading Gen secrets, including the OpenRouter-only path.
- Adds an off-by-default manual sync_generation_secrets input; secret uploads require workflow_dispatch on production. OpenRouter-only takes precedence when selected.
- Preserves the separate scoped-approval requirement and existing deploy-before-secret-upload ordering. No credential values are changed.
- Validated all 16 event/ref/input combinations and both false defaults. Actionlint passes excluding its unsupported pre-existing concurrency.queue key.

gist.headline: Secrets stay in the hive
gist.blurb: Production deploys now keep Gen secrets tucked away unless someone explicitly asks for the sync. The bees still follow the same careful deployment path; they just do not carry credentials by default.
gist.summary: The production Cloudflare workflow now makes Gen secret uploads opt-in through a disabled-by-default sync_generation_secrets workflow_dispatch input, including the OpenRouter-only path, while retaining scoped approval and deploy-before-upload ordering.
gist.impact: Production pushes can deploy without automatically syncing Gen credentials, while authorized manual runs can still sync either the full set or the OpenRouter-only secret path.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful release gardener placing a small sealed secret envelope into a locked garden shed only after turning an explicit manual lever; a cozy production deploy terminal and approval stamp show that the deployment still happens first. Use flowers and code-vines to make the safety gate feel like deliberate stewardship rather than alarm.
